lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice summarizing a review and adding a short personal reaction.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Reading a short review before deciding whether to book, watch, or visit something.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Mediating a review, separating source opinion from personal reaction, and making a decision.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a short review of a guided city walk and decide whether the review is enough to book it.

main_focus.name: review summary with recensenten tycker att
main_focus.description: Report a reviewer's opinion and then add a personal reaction without blending the two.
model_examples: Recensenten tycker att guiden är kunnig men tempot är högt.
Själv blir jag lite tveksam eftersom turen verkar lång.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use reviewer-source framing 2-3 times and personal reaction framing 2-3 times.

allowed_supporting_grammar: hedging with verkar and låter som

useful_chunks: Det räcker nog för att bestämma oss.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use review-source vocabulary and chunks that clearly separate source view from personal view.

dialogue_shape.opening: They introduce a short review and the decision it should help with.
dialogue_shape.middle: They summarize the reviewer's view, identify one limitation, and add a personal reaction.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide whether to book or look for more information.

target_complexity.repetition: source and personal-reaction frames should be clearly contrasted

focus: the main point of the review summary
the personal reaction to the review
the decision about booking or seeking more information

sentence_focus: one sentence reporting what a reviewer thinks
one sentence starting with enligt recensionen
one sentence adding a personal reaction with själv
one sentence describing a limitation with verkar
one sentence deciding whether the review is enough
